enrollment.unit: original trade identity plus exact mapped SIG exchange; each identity-to-exchange mapping consumed once even when excluded
enrollment.requiredClockOrder: trade.received <= trade.available <= sourceExport.asOf <= export.observerAvailable <= decision; original trade.source <= decision; original external source/receipt/availability causal
enrollment.denominator: unique valid mapped units after original external/trigger guards, before SIG state, spacing or label-capacity classification
enrollment.identityConflictOrIdentityCap: stop this offline derivation with explicit bounded failure; do not evict identities or retry them
enrollment.storageFailure: existing trace failure or non-normal/incomplete witness forbids a complete-cohort claim; preserve original active limits and files
enrollment.earlySeal: right censor remaining observations; never extend the active capture

stateAtDecision.source: only already observer-available original verified target book; no future cache lookup
preserve: coverage boundary and observed gap/conflict metadata
stateAtDecision.ageBoundaryResolution: compute exact nonnegative original duration; (3000,10000], (10000,60000], (60000,300000], (300000,infinity); array lower bounds denote integer-millisecond presentation only
stateAtDecision.gapHandling: retain prior verified state only as lagged historical features with explicit gap flag; never current depth or cross-gap labels
stateAtDecision.conflictingFutureOrMissingState: metadata and missingness flags only, no numeric book feature
stateAtDecision.oldThreeSecondBookEligibilityFlag: diagnostic on same prospective inputs only; do not reinterpret prior cohort outputs
stateAtDecision.uncertainty: age and missingness are inputs, not assigned probability/confidence; future sparse strata must abstain under a separate fit protocol
stateAtDecision.pilotOutput: hashes, clocks, ages, state-presence/validity and feature-availability metadata only; no price/return outcome evaluation

labels.timeOrigin: original observer decision callback at first eligible trade observation
labels.fixedHorizonRule: first subsequently available genuine target book with original source, receipt and observer availability all in [decision+horizon, decision+horizon+slack], after applicable continuity boundary; source and receipt ages at availability each <=3000ms
labels.bookVersion: original sequence then exact original asOf.at, with original conflicts and rollback refusals
values: no economic values read or reported in pilot; later preregistered model may use original bid/ask/midpoint levels
labels.staleReferenceDifference: optional descriptive change from lagged state; includes unobserved pre-trigger movement and is not causal trade impact or executable return
labels.secondaryNextObservation: first original target observation with source and receipt strictly after decision and observer availability later than decision; source/receipt ages at availability <=3000ms; report variable delay and gap flags, right censor at 123000ms, no fixed-horizon return claim
labels.futureFees: unknown for execution; no hypothetical trade PnL or assumed fill in this pilot
labels.pilotOutput: availability/status and original clocks only; no sample/label price values, returns or fit

primary: disjoint unique-unit enrollment and exclusion counts on fixed future V5 input interval
old-three-second book eligibility by age band
label availability at every fixed horizon by age band, market and time block
next genuine observation delay and censoring
source-to-receipt and receipt-to-first-availability distributions with missing components explicit
analysis.populationInference: observed poll-visible external trades and observed-label subset only; event-driven target publication is informative missingness
analysis.ifLabelsRemainScarce: do not extend age/slack after outcomes; separately review exogenous signal-independent scheduled/randomized label reads through the existing sole worker and budget

v3FinalCounterObservation.provenance: root read metadata only from retained original private status.json and supplied counters in task message; artifact hash and full-file bytes not independently verified by this design author

inputPlan.cohortIdentity: root V5 original input-trace cohort live verified 2026-10-16T17:38:10Z observing sole SIG525450; final original seal hash pinned at normal completion
inputPlan.startingState: replay entire original run-start prefix before the fixed enrollment interval, preserving exact callback order/now and first-seen consumed identities
inputPlan.missingRequiredOriginalWitness: abstain and report exact missing field; no reconstructed clocks or synthetic source witness
